notes: Corrected the three-level chain סֵפֶר תּוֹרַת הָאֱלֹהִים → 'the book of the law of God': the innermost rectum carries an article and is rendered with no determiner, so the 'the' before 'law' is that article's fronted one level and the outer construct takes the supplied 'the' (rule 29); the article had been marked unrepresented while the middle construct held a supplied 'the'. This matches NEH.8.16's treatment of בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים in the same chapter.
